title: Is the per-valve VALVE-179 safe bound valid under joint PRV action?

env.determinism: EPANET's hydraulic solver is deterministic. No stochastic input is used anywhere in Phase 5; leak-node selection and leak-coefficient allocation are closed-form functions of pipe length, so no random seed is required. Recorded seed: none used.

scope_statement: Characterisation only. Grids fixed before execution. No optimisation, no search, no reward, no RL. Native controls, rules and topology untouched in every run.
question: Does any tested combination in which VALVE-179 is at or below its per-valve safe bound of 44.7 psi still produce negative service pressure? If yes, a per-valve box constraint is not by itself a sufficient safety layer.
